positions.title: Senior Web Engineer I
positions.description:
Lead developer involved with launching a record number of new products from a personalization and print rendering aspect.

Responsible for training new hires, mentoring interns, deciphering product requirements, and providing developer task breakdowns and estimates.

Regularly engaged to come up with solutions for time sensitive issues facing both internal teams and 3rd party vendors.

positions.title: Web Engineer II
positions.description:
Contributed to customer facing projects across the full stack and became an owner for our print rendering pipeline.

Cooperated cross-functionally to deliver API and service enhancements, delivering quickly and with quality.

A highlight of my time as Web Engineer II was placing 3rd in Shutterfly's Hack Day with a 3D product preview feature using Three.js. This is now a customer facing feature on both Tiny Prints and Wedding Paper Divas.

positions.title: Web Engineer I
positions.description:
Full-stack web development with a heavier focus on image rendering and front-end development using JavaScript, PHP, ImageMagick, Java, and Adobe ExtendScript.

Developed reusable JavaScript widgets customers use throughout the year.

Fixed browser compatibility bugs, debugged and fixed production issues, and wrote batch scripts to support large scale file migrations.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Professional Services
positions.description:
Worked in a small team whose primary objective was to fulfill one-off requests for custom applications tied to product sales.

Excelled in rapidly prototyping solutions for sales demos.

Developed applications based on customer specifications ranging in scope from small callflow scripts to full blown scheduling applications complete with a relational database and administrative tool.

Granted the Vertical Star Award in December 2011 for excellence in performance.

positions.title: Sustaining Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for triaging high priority customer escalations, implementing fixes when appropriate, and developing troubleshooting tools for customers.

Bridged communication gaps between our customers, tech support staff, and engineering teams.

In between performing sustaining duties, helped perform basic acceptance and regression tests as part of a major release effort.

Required to build and retain knowledge of practically every component and subsystem of the product and quickly familiarize myself with unique customer configurations.

A highlight of my time as a sustaining engineer was when I created a C# application for CVS Pharmacy to easily view, filter, and troubleshoot Drive-Thru sensor events. I was personally congratulated on the effectiveness of the tool when CVS came to visit two years later.
